description: DBGT10K_22_v05 - 04 Linea Costa Marina is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by GeoDati - RNDT. E' la linea ''ideale'' dove terraferma e mare si incontrano. Può essere naturale, artificiale (in presenza cioè di manufatti sia di difesa che di servizio) o fittizia (in corrispondenza di foci di corsi d'acqua, di adiacenza con particolari specchi d'acqua quali lagune o laghi costieri) ed è generalmente caratterizzata da un nome. Coverage: GeoDati - RNDT. The portal files it under the publisher GeoDati - RNDT. Its tags are acquedotti, cartografia-di-base, ctr, database-geotopografico, dbgt. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
